page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head above the text with page number at left; marginal notes in the left margin; a catchword-like fragment at the foot of the text block.

main_text.p: liter, Carnaliter, Oraliter adesse & (quæ Berengario præiuit bonus ille Papa Nicolaus, illumque secutus, Alanus nofter) dentibus teri, dilaniarique, impium nobis semper videbitur & (Augustino iudice) flagitiosum. Placet hîc Ariæ Montani candor, qui in Lucæ 22. Hoc est corpus meum; id est, Verum corpus meum in hoc Sacramento panis continetur sacramentaliter; subditque, vti Nicodemus alter (nocturnus Christi alumnus) Cuius arcanam & mysterijs retertissimam rationem, vt explicatiorem habeant Christiani, dabit aliquando Domi-De doctr. Chr. l. 3.Montan. in Luc. 22. 19.In verf. 18.

page.notes: Left margin notes are faint and partly illegible; only the legible references are transcribed. The catchword "nus" is the word completing "Dominus" at the foot of the column.
